title: intake's drift and trailers fingerprints hash their whole finding set, so a changed set or a budget-dependent drift scan files the same findings again
goal: The drift and trailers detectors each give one fingerprint that does not change while the detector keeps reporting (a stable per-detector key), so intake --file and the SessionStart hook keep one open item per detector whatever commits enter or leave the window, which items drift, or which checks the drift budget reached; that item's repro intake --status <fp> exits 1 while the detector reports anything and 0 once it reports nothing; backlog.md's fingerprint sentence says so; tests plant a window that drops a commit, a drift scan whose budget reaches different items, and a second --file run that files nothing

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import bl_intake as b; a=b.collect('.',only='trailers')[0]; b.TRAILER_WINDOW_DAYS=5; c=b.collect('.',only='trailers')[0]; sys.exit(1 if a and c and a[0].fp != c[0].fp else 0)

notes: Sprint review of SP-3brmvlnh: three drift runs a minute apart gave two fingerprints as the budget reached different items; the trailers key is the sorted short shas, so a window that slides past one commit files a second bug while the first stays open and its repro passes.
